responsibility: This header defines the `neoversen2_tunings` model for Arm Neoverse N2 in the AArch64 backend. It contributes N2-specific register-move costs, AdvSIMD and SVE vector cost tables, scalar/vector issue-resource descriptions, SVE width, issue rate, and tune flags such as matched vector throughput and predicate-RMW avoidance, making it the dedicated microarchitectural profile for Neoverse N2 cost modeling and scheduling.
